preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= 10**5 for x in stdin.split()[:2])
preconditions.description: Input contains two integers n and d where 1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5 and 0 ≤ d ≤ 10^9.

preconditions.expression: len(stdin.split()) == 2 + n and all(1 <= int(x) <= 10**15 for x in stdin.split()[2:])
preconditions.description: Input contains exactly n integers h1, h2, ..., hn where 1 ≤ hi ≤ 10^15.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip().split() == [str(k)] + [str(i) for i in sequence] and len(sequence) == k
postconditions.description: Output consists of an integer k (the maximal length of a jump sequence) followed by k integers representing the indices of the pillars in the sequence.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= i <= n for i in sequence) and all(i < j for i, j in zip(sequence, sequence[1:]))
postconditions.description: All pillar indices in the sequence are valid (1 ≤ i ≤ n) and strictly increasing.

postconditions.expression: all(abs(h[sequence[i]-1] - h[sequence[i+1]-1]) >= d for i in range(k-1))
postconditions.description: For every consecutive pair of pillars in the sequence, the absolute difference in their heights is at least d.

postconditions.expression: k == max(len(seq) for seq in valid_sequences)
postconditions.description: The length k of the sequence is maximal among all valid jump sequences.
